Trump dismisses AI risks as hoax; Johnson calls warnings 'stupid'

Former U.S. President Donald Trump described warnings about the risks of artificial intelligence as a "hoax" and a "sick conspiracy." House Speaker Mike Johnson stated that media coverage of AI threats is "spun up" and a "stupid, knee-jerk reaction." These comments come amid broader discussions about the potential dangers of AI, with some Republicans also expressing concerns.
